Paragraph: "I presume these two... those best of men are abetted by Vali to assault me... for, the kings like Vali do have many friends and trusting them absolutely is an unpardonable mistake..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Deep-seated mistrust and fear of deception born from political/family strife.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva shares his pragmatic survival rule: misplaced trust in politics is fatal.
Outcome/Resolution: He maintains cautious paranoia as a defensive strategy.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: A-Vishvasana (Pragmatic non-trust adopted due to past encounters with deceit)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Worldly experience teaches caution, but blind mistrust can inadvertently close the door on divine grace.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Protective mistrust: adopting a hyper-defensive posture to prevent recurrent emotional or physical trauma.
